_readme: CANONICAL SkillBridge resource catalog — the single source of truth. The website renders it, `npm run resources:check` validates it, and `npm run resources:sync` writes a verified snapshot into the content repo for Creator Flow CTA validation. Never hand-edit the snapshot. Only `status: published` items render in production.

friction.age-16: Some steps need you to be 16+

resources.title: SkillBridge Starter Toolkit
resources.description: A curated list of the free tools, sites, and opportunities we currently recommend — and the traps that charge you in two weeks.
resources.outcome: You get the shortlist we actually use, in one file.

source.note: Verified copy, rendered verbatim. Renamed from "Everything We Use" on 2026-07-28 — that title overclaimed. Do not paraphrase the body: edit toolkit.json, then run npm run pdf.

resources.title: The No-Experience Project Starter
resources.description: Choose one project you can finish in two weeks, prove it with a link or a number, and write the resume line — without calling yourself an intern.
resources.outcome: You leave with one project chosen, scoped, and written down.

resources.title: First Internship Application Kit
resources.description: The three things to check before you submit, the message to send after, and when to let it go — none of it asking you to invent experience.
resources.outcome: You leave with a checked application and one message ready to send.

resources.title: 3 Better Networking Questions
resources.description: The three questions to ask at a career fair instead of the ones you could have Googled — plus the one thing to do with the answers that night.
resources.outcome: You leave with three questions on your phone and a next move.

resources.title: 5 Free Credentials Before Graduation
resources.description: Five official programs offering free credentials, badges, or certificates — and the reason you should only finish one of them.
resources.outcome: You leave having picked one credential that matches a project.

source.note: All five provider pages re-opened and confirmed live 2026-07-28. Cisco's skillsforall.com now redirects to netacad.com — the catalog and PDF use the current URL.

resources.title: The High-School Resume Starter
resources.description: A one-page template built for someone with no formal job yet. Every line is a prompt you replace. City and state only, no street address, no objective.
resources.outcome: You leave with a resume you can fill in and export today.

source.note: Opens in Word, Google Docs, or Pages. Written to the corrected editorial rules: city/state only, no street address, ZIP, age, photo, or generic objective.

resources.title: The AI Tools Guide
resources.description: Which AI to use for which job, what each one is actually best at, and prompts you can adapt for resumes, mock interviews, outreach, and studying.
resources.outcome: You stop guessing which tool to open.

source.note: Skyler's AI Tools Guide, updated June 2026. Read-only /preview link — the owner ouid parameter from the original share URL is stripped. Anonymous access confirmed 2026-07-28. Contains its own privacy rule: never paste your full name plus address, passwords, school logins, or family financial info into an AI tool.

resources.title: LinkedIn Best Practices
resources.description: How to set up the profile: the photo, the headline, the About section, and the parts most students leave blank.
resources.outcome: You leave with a profile someone would actually reply to.

source.note: SkillBridge's own LinkedIn deck. Read-only /preview link. Anonymous access confirmed 2026-07-28. NOTE FOR SKYLER: one headline example on the deck names your club and school. Fine if intentional — say the word and it can be swapped for a neutral example.

resources.title: Blank resume template (Google Doc)
resources.description: The editable Google Doc version of the resume template from the Discord resume drop.
resources.outcome: An editable copy students can make in one click.

source.note: Anonymous access confirmed 2026-07-28 and the OBJECTIVE section has already been removed from the live doc.

resources.blockedReason: The contact line still reads 'City, State Zipcode', which prompts students to publish a ZIP code. The approved editorial rule is city and state only. One edit to that line in the Doc clears this and the item can flip to published — no code change needed.

resources.title: Filled-in example resume (Google Doc)
resources.description: A completed sample resume showing what each section looks like when it is filled in.
resources.outcome: A worked example to compare your own draft against.

source.note: Anonymous access confirmed 2026-07-28. The person in it is fictional, so there is no real-privacy problem.

resources.blockedReason: The example prints a ZIP code ('Los Angeles, California 90024') and leads with a generic objective — the two things the approved editorial rule tells students not to do. Publishing it would teach the opposite of the template. Two edits to the Doc clear it.

resources.title: The Interviewing Pack
resources.description: The interviewing slides, the quick-reference sheet, and the mock-interview prep and scenario from the Discord interviewing drop.
resources.outcome: A full interview-prep set students can work through alone.
